info.title: yauth
info.description: Modular, plugin-based authentication API for Axum applications.

ActiveOrgResponse.description:
Response payload for the active-org switcher endpoints.

`active_org_id` is the currently-active org (or `None` if cleared).
`orgs` is the full membership list the caller can switch into — small
and bounded, so we always return it (saves a follow-up roundtrip when
rendering an org picker).

`bearer_access_token` is populated ONLY for bearer-auth callers on
switch: cookie sessions update server-side and need no token rotation,
while JWT bearer requires a freshly-issued token carrying the new
`org`/`role`/`orgs` claims.

AdminSessionInfo.description: Session info returned by admin list endpoint.

AdminUserInfo.description: User info returned by admin list endpoint.

activates_at.description:
Scheduled start; while in the future the user is "staged" and cannot
authenticate yet.

suspended.description:
Whether the account is globally suspended (offboarded). Distinct from
`banned` (security incidents).

kind.description: Sanitized kind — secrets (hmac_secret, hec_token, api_key) are stripped.

AuthConfigResponse.description: Server-side auth configuration exposed to frontends via `GET /config`.

allow_signups.description: Whether new user registration is allowed.

require_email_verification.description: Whether newly registered users must verify their email before logging in.

active_org_id.description:
Active organization claim (issue #89). `None` for single-tenant
deployments or users with no memberships. Populated from the session
row (cookie auth) or from the JWT's `org` claim (bearer auth).

all_orgs.description:
Compact membership list — one entry per organization the user
belongs to. Populated alongside `active_org_id`. Empty when the
`organizations` feature is off or the user has no memberships.

org_role.description:
The caller's role in `active_org_id`. Resolved at auth time from the
membership row (cookie) or from the JWT's `role` claim. `None` when
`active_org_id` is `None`.

role.description:
New role to assign. Must be a built-in role (`admin`,
`billing_admin`, `member`, `viewer`) or a custom string the
application recognizes. `owner` is rejected — use the
transfer-ownership endpoint instead.

ClientRegistrationRequest.description:
RFC 7591 §2 Dynamic Client Registration request body. Matches yauth-go's
`dcrRegisterRequest` exactly so the TS client serves both backends.

`private_key_jwt` clients can register a `public_key_pem` value via this
endpoint, but the field is intentionally **not** part of the typed schema
— yauth-go does not accept it, and we'd rather keep the spec converged
than add a Rust-only extension. Instead, the handler reads the raw JSON
body and pulls `public_key_pem` out alongside the typed parse.

jwks_uri.description: Reserved for the runtime JWKS-URI fetch path (not yet implemented).

ClientRegistrationResponse.description:
RFC 7591 §3.2.1 Dynamic Client Registration success body. Mirrors
yauth-go's `dcrRegisterResponse` so a single TS client can drive both
backends.

client_secret_expires_at.description: Unix seconds. `0` means the secret never expires (or there is no secret).

registration_access_token.description:
JWT scoped to registration management of `client_id`. RFC 7592 §2
management endpoints are not yet implemented; the token is emitted
for forward compatibility.

scope.description:
Space-separated scope list, echoed back per RFC 7591 §3.2.1. Empty
when the client did not request any scopes.

auto_join_on_signup.description:
Auto-add matching users to the org on signup / email verification.
Defaults to `false` — the org must explicitly opt in.

default_role_on_auto_join.description: Role granted on auto-join. Defaults to `"member"`.

domain.description: Domain to claim (e.g. `"acme.com"`). Canonicalized to lowercase.

require_email_verified.description:
Auto-join only after the user has verified their address.
Defaults to `true` (anti-abuse).

CreateDomainResponse.description:
Returned by `POST /organizations/:id/domains` — wraps the claim plus
the **verification token**, which is returned exactly once at claim
time. Clients must surface it to the operator so they can publish the
DNS TXT record `_yauth-domain-verify.<domain>` containing the token.

token.description:
Plaintext token — returned exactly once at creation. Caller is
responsible for delivering it to the invitee (email, etc.).

permissions.description:
Free-form permission list. The handler enforces that every
requested permission is a subset of what the caller's own role
allows by default.

role.description:
Org-role the bearer acts as. Must be one of the built-in roles
except `owner` (defense-in-depth: a leaked service-account key
must not be able to delete the org). Defaults to `member`.

secret.description: Plaintext secret — returned exactly once at creation.

type.description: Event type filter — corresponds to yauth-go's `?type=` query param.

LockoutLockedAccount.description:
One row in the admin lockout listing. Mirrors yauth-go's
`LockoutLockedAccountJSON`.

MfaAuthResponse.description:
Envelope returned by `POST /mfa/verify` after a TOTP/backup code passes.
Matches yauth-go's `MfaVerifyResponse`.

OAuthAuthResponse.description:
Envelope returned by `POST|GET /oauth/{provider}/callback` after a
successful exchange. Matches yauth-go's `OauthCallbackResponse`.

Oauth2AuthorizeRedirect.description:
Response for `POST /oauth2/consent` (and the inline-mint branch of
`GET /oauth/authorize`). Mirrors yauth-go's `Oauth2AuthorizeRedirect`.

Oauth2ClientView.description:
Public-facing serialization of an OAuth2 client. Matches yauth-go's
`Oauth2ClientJSON`.

name.description:
yauth-go calls this field `name` on the wire — keep the Rust field
`client_name` (closer to the domain model) but rename for serde.

approved.description:
`true` to mint an authorization code and redirect with `?code=...`;
`false` to deny and redirect with `?error=access_denied`.

csrf_token.description:
CSRF token issued alongside `request_id`. Constant-time-compared with
the stored value to prevent cross-site approve/deny attacks.

request_id.description:
Opaque id returned by `GET /oauth/authorize` identifying the pending
authorization request to finalize.

Oauth2CreateClientRequest.description:
Body for `POST /oauth2/clients`. Admin-scoped client creation; mirrors
yauth-go's `Oauth2CreateClientRequest`.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description:
Explicit `token_endpoint_auth_method` override. When omitted the
server picks one based on `is_public` / whether `public_key_pem` or
`jwks_uri` is set.

client_secret.description:
Plaintext secret returned exactly once on creation. Empty for public
clients (where `is_public=true` or `private_key_jwt` is in use).

Oauth2PatchClientRequest.description:
Body for `PATCH /oauth2/clients/{id}`. Mirrors yauth-go's
`Oauth2PatchClientRequest`. Each field is optional; omitting a field
leaves it unchanged.

client_secret.description:
Plaintext IdP client secret. yauth encrypts it at rest via the
configured `SecretCipher`. The plaintext NEVER leaves this
request boundary — list/get responses surface only the masked
form.

**Masked** — always `"********"`. The real client secret is
never returned over the wire after the original PUT/POST.

OrgMembership.description:
Compact membership descriptor surfaced on [`AuthUser`] (issue #89).

Lightweight enough to drop into JWT claims and SSR-render org switchers
without a follow-up API roundtrip.

PaginatedSessionsResponse.description: Response type for `GET /admin/sessions` (schema-only, used for OpenAPI spec).

PaginatedUsersResponse.description: Response type for `GET /admin/users` (schema-only, used for OpenAPI spec).

permissions.description:
Permission identifiers in `domain:verb` form (e.g.
`members:invite`, `billing:view`). Stable identifiers — safe to
pin in UI guards.

PolicyResponse.description:
Wire-format response for the per-org policy.

Mirrors [`OrganizationPolicy`] but flattens the `SessionBinding` /
`AuthMethod` enums to strings — keeps the OpenAPI schema legible
for the generated TS client.

RegisterResponse.description:
Envelope returned by `POST /register` — wraps the newly-created user and
carries an optional human-readable message. Matches yauth-go's
`EmailPasswordRegisterResponse`.

SamlConfigInput.description:
Admin payload for a SAML SP connection (issue #94).

`assertion_signed_required` and `response_signed_required` are
**strict booleans** — omitting them defaults to `true`, but
explicitly passing `false` is a knowingly-accepted footgun and is
recorded in the audit log.

sp_private_key.description:
Optional SP private key (PEM). yauth encrypts at rest. Plaintext
NEVER leaves this request boundary — list/get masks to a fixed
`"********"`. Only needed when SP signing or encrypted-assertion
decryption is required.

idp_x509_cert.description:
**Masked** when set — always `"********"`. The IdP cert is
non-secret but we still don't echo it on list to keep response
sizes small; admins refetch it from the IdP if they need to
re-import.

sp_private_key.description:
**Masked** when set — always `"********"`. `None` if SP signing
was never configured.

activates_at.description: Scheduled start (RFC 3339). Null/absent clears it (active now).

SessionResponse.description:
Envelope returned by `GET /session` — wraps the authenticated user and
surfaces session expiry. Matches the yauth-go `EmailPasswordSessionResponse`
shape so a single TypeScript client serves both backends.

qr_code.description:
Server-rendered QR code as a `data:image/png;base64,...` URL. CLI/mobile
clients render this directly; web clients can fall back to building
their own from `otpauth_url`. Empty string if rendering failed.

oneOf.description:
Present when `kind == "oidc_client"`. Always carries the
masked secret form — see [`OidcConfigResponse`].

Present when `kind == "saml_sp"`. Always carries the masked
private-key form — see [`SamlConfigResponse`].

detail.description: Human-readable detail of what was checked / what failed.

ok.description:
Whether the round-trip succeeded. Currently the test is a
structural check (config decodes, discovery URL well-formed).
Live discovery + JWKS validation lands in Phase B.

org.description:
Optional organization ID to mint a JWT scoped to a specific org
(issue #118). When supplied the caller must be an active member of
that org; otherwise 403 is returned. When omitted the existing
auto-selection behaviour is preserved.

new_owner_user_id.description: UUID of the existing member who should become the new owner.

max_session_duration_secs.description:
`None` (omitted) = "leave unchanged"; `Some(None)` = "clear",
`Some(Some(n))` = "set". Same convention as the org domain
update payload — admins clear an override by sending `null`.

oneOf.description:
Replaces the full OIDC config blob. PATCH-merging into a JSON
blob that holds an encrypted secret is gnarly; admins re-send
the whole document instead.

Replaces the full SAML config blob. Same merge semantics as
`oidc`.

WebhookDetailResponse.description:
Response envelope for `GET /webhooks/{id}` — wraps just the webhook.
Recent deliveries moved to the dedicated paginated
`GET /webhooks/{id}/deliveries` endpoint to mirror yauth-go.

WebhookTestResponse.description:
Response for `POST /webhooks/{id}/test`. Carries the queued delivery's id
so the caller can poll `/webhooks/{id}/deliveries` for the result. Mirrors
yauth-go's `WebhookTestResponse`.
